name: pyrun
description: Sandboxed Python compute for the AI agent: run small programs over attached files and save the results.
help: Pyrun lets the AI run small, bounded Python programs in a sealed sandbox instead of burning agent steps on mechanical data crunching: the agent attaches files it already owns, computes aggregates, filters and reshapes tables with pyrun.compute, reads back plain values, and persists named text results with pyrun.save into a validated drive destination — never an agent-supplied path. Every run is bounded (no imports, no filesystem, no network) and recorded in the AI usage log.
